method: Adjusted-close cumulative return, normalized to the trading day before the filing date. Day 0 is the first trading date on/after filing. Filing time is not available; after-hours filings may react on the following session.
limitations: Bounded convenience sample from historical exports, not a representative market study. These are raw price reactions, NOT benchmark-adjusted abnormal returns or causal effects. Other news and stale data can confound interpretation. No filing full text is republished.
